verdict.rationale: Ramp's site claims hotel rate monitoring with automatic rebooking when prices drop by $50 or more. That covers the core automated monitor-and-rebook behavior, but only for hotels, only above a fixed threshold, and only in a single marketing line. Missing for 10: monitoring and rebooking for other travel types such as flights, detailed first-party docs on how monitoring and rebooking work (configurability, agent/API access to this feature), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
